from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2528aad7.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    zeros = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    z0, z1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    x0, x1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    for i in range(z1-z0+1):
        for j in range(x1-x0+1):
            out[z0+i][x0+j] = grid[r0+i][c1-j]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
